title: Duskull 62/100 Pokemon EX Sandstorm Reverse Holo 2003 e-Reader Nintendo Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Duskull 62/100 Pokemon EX Sandstorm Reverse Holo card from 2003 is a vintage collectible from the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This Common card features the character Duskull with an HP of 40, illustrated by Aya Kusube. Manufactured by Nintendo, the card is in English and part of the EX Sandstorm set. With a standard card size and made of card stock, this Basic Pokémon card is a sought-after item for collectors.
